title: Universal Formula Families for Safe Stabilization of Single-Input Nonlinear Systems
summary: We develop an optimization-free framework for safe stabilization of single-input control-affine nonlinear systems with a given control Lyapunov function (CLF) and a given control barrier function (CBF), where the desired equilibrium lies in the interior of the safe set. An explicit compatibility condition is derived that is necessary and sufficient for the pointwise simultaneous satisfaction of the CLF and CBF inequalities.
